_note: Recorded baselines for the tick-harness fixtures (M12 close-out). Counts and totals are asserted literally by the libbars trim/soak tests; this file is the human-readable record with bounds and geometry. Times are observed on the recording machine, never asserted: a slower machine still passes, and a hang reports as an executed-test timeout to file, never as a threshold to tweak. Red tests fix the test's understanding or file new work, never the engine and never a silent edit here.

recording.harness: two-module linked closure (libUtil + libBars) with a fetch-only driver; Bars.init(M1, M1, D1)

harness_bounds.concurrency: single-threaded bar-by-bar evaluation; no fan-out, no queues, no broadcast (C45-style bound: none exist)
harness_bounds.per_tick_work: bounded by ring capacity (max_candles, 10 on this geometry) plus the pull window (calc_bars_count 300); no per-tick allocation grows with run length
harness_bounds.refusal_discipline: tick/bar length mismatch refuses fail-closed; unregistered (symbol, timeframe) pairs refuse like live fetch; ragged injection refuses at inject time
harness_bounds.chart_period: never enters Bars mechanics (legs plus init args do); fixtures run the M6 chart scope, the soak runs the proof minute scope

quiet.why: first-two-tick seeding rounds to zero, so the accumulator holds the full tape and the remainder has nothing to add

pull.injection: last SPY_1M.csv row at or before the window open (1767995760, 1062 units)
pull.why: 8.29% seeding drift trips the 4% gate; the ring rebuilds from the confirmed 1062-unit row, which equals the leg, so the zero-magnitude remainder adds no second row

sparse.geometry: one constant bar-open (1767995580000) across three minutes; middle minute has no trades
sparse.why: the first tick past the hole crosses two LTF boundaries (one counted gap); both populated minutes finalize and the remainder tops the bar

out_of_order.why: the four out-of-order flags ride the unread side channel, so accumulation matches the tape exactly; the 561-unit seeding loss tops up through the remainder path with no pull

pull_remainder.injection: last SPY_1M.csv row at or before the window open (1767995400, 299 units)
pull_remainder.why: 35.91% seeding drift trips the 4% gate; the ring rebuilds from the confirmed 299-unit row and the abs-remainder rule ADDS one unit, landing on 300 (one above both leg and confirmed)

soak.asserts: every row evaluates once with zero refusals; final pull_count >= 1; final bar reconstructs
soak.proof_bound: the full-closure proof of the same tape observes ~655s; the light harness runs ~4x faster (two modules vs eight)
